title: Smoothness results for the schemes of special divisors on general k-gonal curves
summary: For a general $k$-gonal curve $C$ with a morphism $f: C \rightarrow \mathbb{P}^1$ of degree $k$, we consider the refinement of the Brill-Noether schemes $W^r_d(C)$ by means of the Brill-Noether degeneracy schemes $\overlineΣ_{\overrightarrow {e}}(C,f)$. The schemes $\overlineΣ_{\overrightarrow {e}}(C,f)$ as sets are closures of subsets $Σ_{\overrightarrow {e}}(C,f)$ of $\Pic (C)$ and as a scheme $Σ_{\overrightarrow {e}}(C,f)$ is a smooth open subscheme of $\overlineΣ_{\overrightarrow {e}}(C,f)$.
